**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939)
I am not certain whether it was mentioned that sheets of the [Trial](../books.html#53) were to be sent to [Messrs Williams and Norgate](../others.html#165) to be forwarded to [M.

Tauchnitz](../persons.html#1396).

He has just written to me to ask for them which makes me mention it.
I send the chapters of The Trial, all but the three last, which shall follow in a week or fortnight.

Yours faithfully
C. M.

Yonge

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
